question: Is the S2 gain of the uncertainty-aware dispatch (forecast + 1.66 >= 6, i.e. forecast >= 4.34) a forecast effect, or only the effect of calling the bus at a smaller queue?
frozen: committed before any run of this ablation
seeds: S2, seeds 201-220: not used by any earlier matrix (those used 1-20) nor by the choice of q (development seeds 101-120)

policies.predictive: installed configuration of the tested revision (dispatch_upper_quantile 0.8, observed floor at dispatch_high 6, re-arm)
policies.reactive-6: observed queue >= 6 (dispatch_low 4): the baseline of the matrices

hysteresis: dispatch_low = dispatch_high - 2, the gap of the 6 / 4 default; no other parameter changes
no_selection: all three reactive thresholds are reported; none is chosen on the test seeds
primary: all-passenger wait (lower bound), paired delta predictive - reactive-5 and predictive - reactive-4 per seed, 95 % whole-episode bootstrap interval
decision: if predictive is lower than both reactive-5 and reactive-4 with intervals below 0, the gain is attributed to the forecast; if a lower reactive threshold is as good or better, the report states that the gain comes from calling earlier and the forecast is not needed for it
run: ros2 run smart_hub dispatch_ablation --parallel 3 (test-matrix machinery: attempt IDs, single infrastructure re-run, graph audit)
